about: HO1 (docs/strategy/05 section D): 'I want a person' recognised by code, before any model, in Lebanese Arabic, Arabizi, English and French (packages/agents/src/person-request.ts). expect 'person': a case of kind person_requested opens, the customer gets the opened line with a call-me-back button, and the bot keeps answering. expect 'chase': while a case is open, the customer asks after it; the short 'your request is open' answers it (at most every 10 minutes; otherwise the Concierge answers). expect 'none': neither; the turn goes on as before. The person and chase texts are the simulated customers' own words from the SIM1 run (docs/SIM_REPORT_2026-11-15.md, evals/cases/sim_silence_after_handoff.json) plus invented ones. Every wrong match found later is added here before the pattern changes.
